subject: The newsletters outside Diffbot's crawl
body:
Diffbot's Knowledge Graph is built by crawling the public web, described on your own pages as an RSS feed for every press release, blog, newspaper and magazine. Newsletters are the one publishing format outside that path: they arrive by email and they sit behind Substack and beehiiv.

NewsletterFIT reads that layer and turns each issue into graph shaped records: companies, people, guests, topics and sponsor placements, with the publication, the article URL and the date attached. An AI pass does the extraction, so the output is entities and relationships rather than documents.

The layer is already measured here. Clay appears in 92 articles across 56 publications and Apollo in 102 across 88. Diffbot does not appear yet, which is a coverage question rather than a quality one.

I can send a sample of the records for a sector you already hold, mapped against your ontology.
